instructions: Add one confirmed row per concrete evidence item. Cite canonical source files, copy verifier excerpts verbatim, and judge source presence separately from recovery.

criteria.criterion: Use correct O*NET Summary Report profile (15-1252.00 only)
criteria.description: Information must be taken only from the O*NET OnLine Summary Report for occupation code 15-1252.00 (Software Developers). Full credit if all reported fields clearly correspond to 15-1252.00. Full credit (no penalty) if the agent attempts to access the correct Summary Report but the page is blocked/unavailable and the agent clearly reports this limitation. Partial credit if the agent uses the correct title/code but mixes in any data from another occupation page. No credit if the occupation code is not 15-1252.00 or the source is not the O*NET Summary Report and no access issue is reported.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Screenshot evidence analysis for Criterion 0 shows the O*NET OnLine Summary Report header for “Software Developers” with code “15-1252.00”, including a visible “Bright Outlook” badge (and “Updated 2026”).
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: The agent referenced the correct occupation code/profile context (15-1252.00) and did not introduce any other occupation data. Score remains full.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The screenshot shows the O*NET OnLine page header "O*NET OnLine" and a large occupation heading "Software Developers" with the code "15-1252.00" directly beneath it. A badge/button labeled "Bright Outlook" is visible near the top right of the occupation header area, along with a tag "Updated 2026".
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: The screenshot confirms the correct O*NET Summary Report profile for occupation code 15-1252.00 (Software Developers) is open. The agent’s predicted output references this page but claims inability to see numeric fields; that limitation is not contradicted by the screenshot because the Wages & Employment Trends area is not visible in this capture.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: No discrepancy about using the correct occupation page: the screenshot clearly shows "Software Developers" and "15-1252.00". The agent claimed the numeric wage/employment/growth/openings values were not visible; the screenshot indeed does not show those sections/values.

dom_model_context.verifier_evidence: DOM-model state 0 shows URL https://www.onetonline.org/link/summary/15-1252.00 and page title/header indicating “15-1252.00 - Software Developers” / “Software Developers 15-1252.00 …”. This is direct DOM support that the agent was on the correct O*NET Summary Report profile.
dom_model_context.verifier_justification: The agent did not mix in any other occupation and referenced the correct profile context. No adjustment needed.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: DOM_MODEL_STATE_INDEX: 0 shows URL "https://www.onetonline.org/link/summary/15-1252.00" and page title "15-1252.00 - Software Developers". Visible header text includes "Software Developers 15-1252.00 Bright Outlook Updated 2026".
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis:
EVIDENCE_STATUS: SUPPORTED
The DOM state explicitly corresponds to the O*NET OnLine Summary Report for occupation code 15-1252.00 (Software Developers) via both the URL path (/link/summary/15-1252.00) and the on-page title string.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: No discrepancy with the requirement to use only the 15-1252.00 Summary Report is evident in the provided DOM state.

criteria.description: Report the occupation title and the occupation code exactly as shown on the 15-1252.00 Summary Report. Full credit if both are correct. Partial credit if only one of title or code is correct/complete, OR if both are correct but have minor formatting differences that do not change meaning. Full credit (no penalty) if the agent cannot view these fields due to page access/rendering issues and explicitly states that the title/code could not be retrieved from the page.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Screenshot evidence analysis for Criterion 1 shows the occupation title “Software Developers” and code “15-1252.00” clearly visible in the page header.
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: Despite the title/code being visible, the agent did not actually record them as requested fields in the final report; it only mentioned them in an instructional sentence. This is a controllable omission, so reduce to partial credit.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The occupation title "Software Developers" is displayed prominently near the top. Immediately below it, the occupation code "15-1252.00" is visible.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: The screenshot provides clear evidence of both the occupation title and code. However, the agent’s predicted output did not actually record/transcribe them as the final requested fields; it only referenced them in instructions ("Summary Report page for 'Software Developers 15-1252.00 Bright Outlook Updated 2026'"). This is partial fulfillment at best because the task required reporting the title and code, not just describing where to find them.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: The agent said it could not see numeric values; that is unrelated to title/code. The title and code are visible in the screenshot, yet the agent did not directly provide a structured report listing them as requested.

dom_model_context.verifier_evidence: DOM-model state 0 explicitly contains the occupation title and code in the visible header text: “Software Developers” and “15-1252.00”.
dom_model_context.verifier_justification: Despite the title/code being visible in the DOM, the agent’s final output did not actually report/transcribe the occupation title and code, nor did it explicitly claim they were inaccessible. This is a controllable omission, so the baseline 0/2 remains appropriate.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: DOM_MODEL_STATE_INDEX: 0 visible content includes "Software Developers 15-1252.00" and separate lines "Software Developers" and "15-1252.00".
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis:
EVIDENCE_STATUS: SUPPORTED
The occupation title ("Software Developers") and occupation code ("15-1252.00") are explicitly present in the DOM snapshot.

criteria.description: Report the Bright Outlook status as displayed on the Summary Report (including whether it is present and the status wording). Full credit if it matches page wording. Partial credit if Bright Outlook presence/absence is correct but the wording is paraphrased/incomplete. Full credit (no penalty) if the agent cannot verify Bright Outlook due to page access/rendering issues and explicitly states it could not be confirmed from the profile.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Screenshot evidence analysis for Criterion 2 shows a clearly visible badge labeled exactly “Bright Outlook” next to the occupation header.
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: The agent indicated Bright Outlook in its text (embedded in the instructional reference). This matches the visible label; full credit.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: A labeled badge/button reading "Bright Outlook" is visible to the right of the occupation header area.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: The screenshot confirms Bright Outlook status is present and explicitly labeled "Bright Outlook". The agent’s predicted output includes the phrase “Software Developers 15-1252.00 Bright Outlook Updated 2026,” which is consistent with what is visible (Bright Outlook badge and Updated 2026 tag). This satisfies the presence/wording requirement for Bright Outlook (at least as far as the visible label).
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: No discrepancy: the agent referenced "Bright Outlook" and the screenshot shows "Bright Outlook".

dom_model_context.verifier_evidence: DOM-model state 0 header includes the phrase “Bright Outlook” (e.g., “Software Developers 15-1252.00 Bright Outlook Updated 2026”), confirming the Bright Outlook designation is shown on the page at least at the label level.
dom_model_context.verifier_justification: The agent did not record the Bright Outlook status as a field in the final answer; it only mentioned it in instructions/guidance. Because the DOM supports at least the exact label “Bright Outlook,” partial credit is warranted for recognizing it exists, but not full credit for failing to transcribe it as requested.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: DOM_MODEL_STATE_INDEX: 0 visible header text includes "Software Developers 15-1252.00 Bright Outlook Updated 2026" (contains the phrase "Bright Outlook").
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis:
EVIDENCE_STATUS: PARTIAL
The DOM evidence supports that the page indicates a Bright Outlook designation because the exact phrase "Bright Outlook" appears in the header line. However, the rubric asks for the Bright Outlook status “as displayed” (including status wording). The snapshot does not show any additional Bright Outlook details beyond the phrase itself (e.g., specific Bright Outlook category/criteria), so only presence is confirmed, not a fuller status description.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: Agent predicted output did not explicitly record the Bright Outlook status; it only referenced the phrase in guidance. The DOM supports at least "Bright Outlook" presence, which was not transcribed as the final requested field.

criteria.description: Report the Job Zone title as displayed (preserve capitalization/wording where possible). Full credit if exact. Partial credit if the correct zone is identified but wording/capitalization is slightly altered. Full credit (no penalty) if the agent cannot view the Job Zone due to page access/rendering issues and explicitly states it is not available.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Screenshot evidence analysis for Criterion 3 indicates the Job Zone section/title is not visible in the screenshot (page view shows tabs and Tasks, no Job Zone text).
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: No uncontrollable blocker is shown (only that the current viewport doesn’t show Job Zone). The agent did not record the Job Zone title and instead gave instructions; this is insufficient effort given nothing indicates inability to scroll/navigate. Score to 0.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The screenshot shows tabs ("Summary", "Details", "Custom", "Easy Read", "Veterans", "Español") and a section titled "Occupation-Specific Information" with "Tasks". There is no visible "Job Zone" section or any Job Zone title text in the captured area.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: Because the Job Zone area is not visible in the screenshot, there is no evidence the agent could or did capture the Job Zone title. The agent’s predicted output does not provide a Job Zone title; it only instructs the user to locate it. This fails the requirement to report the Job Zone title.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: The agent claimed inability to view certain fields and did not report Job Zone. The screenshot does not show Job Zone either, so the non-reporting is consistent with what’s visible, but still incomplete relative to the task requirements.

dom_model_context.verifier_evidence: DOM-model state 0 does not show any “Job Zone” label or Job Zone title in the captured viewport; evidence status is UNKNOWN (may exist below the fold). There is no DOM-confirmed blocker like a site error or paywall—just missing capture of that section.
dom_model_context.verifier_justification: Because there is no DOM evidence that Job Zone was inaccessible due to an uncontrollable blocker (only that it isn’t present in the snapshot), full-credit-for-blocker is not justified. The agent also did not report a Job Zone title. Score remains 0/2.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: DOM_MODEL_STATE_INDEX: 0 visible content shows navigation and sections like "Occupation-Specific Information", "Tasks", and "Occupational Requirements". There is no visible section or label containing "Job Zone" or a Job Zone title in the shown viewport text.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis:
EVIDENCE_STATUS: UNKNOWN
The Job Zone title is not present in the provided DOM snapshot viewport text. Absence in this snapshot does not prove it is not on the page; it may be below the fold or in a collapsed section not captured here. Therefore the Job Zone title cannot be verified from this DOM evidence alone.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: The agent predicted output did not provide a Job Zone title, which is consistent with the snapshot lacking Job Zone information.

criteria.criterion: Record annual median wage (national Wages & Employment Trends value)
criteria.description: Report the annual median wage exactly as displayed on the Summary Report using the national Wages & Employment Trends value. Full credit if the correct national value is provided; do not overly penalize minor formatting differences (e.g., missing $) if the number is correct and clearly an annual median wage. Partial credit if a wage is given but it is unclear whether it is the national Wages & Employment Trends value or if a different wage metric/location is used. Full credit (no penalty) if the agent cannot access this value due to page access/rendering issues and clearly reports this.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Screenshot evidence analysis for Criterion 4 shows no “Wages & Employment Trends” section or any wage figure visible in the screenshot.
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: Absence in the single screenshot does not establish an uncontrollable blocker; it likely required scrolling to the relevant section. The agent did not provide the wage. Score to 0.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: No "Wages & Employment Trends" section is visible in the screenshot, and there is no annual median wage figure shown anywhere in the captured view.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: The agent did not provide the annual median wage and stated it was unable to see the numeric national wage value. The screenshot supports that the wage value is not visible in this capture (it’s scrolled to the Tasks section). Therefore, the required wage field is not recorded, resulting in failure to satisfy this criterion.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: No contradiction: the screenshot does not display any wage numbers, aligning with the agent’s claim of not being able to transcribe them from the available view.

dom_model_context.verifier_evidence: DOM-model state 0 does not display the “Wages & Employment Trends” section or any annual median wage dollar figure in the visible DOM; evidence status is UNKNOWN (could be elsewhere on page). No DOM-confirmed site-level blocker is shown.
dom_model_context.verifier_justification: The baseline awarded full credit assuming an uncontrollable blocker, but the DOM evidence only shows that the wage is not in the captured viewport—not that the site prevented access. Since the annual median wage is not reported in the final answer, and there’s no confirmed blocker, the score should be reduced to 0/3.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: DOM_MODEL_STATE_INDEX: 0 visible content does not show a "Wages & Employment Trends" section, any "National" wage table, or any dollar-value text for "annual median wage" in the captured viewport.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis:
EVIDENCE_STATUS: UNKNOWN
The annual median wage (national Wages & Employment Trends value) is not available in the provided DOM snapshot text. It may exist elsewhere on the page outside the visible capture, but cannot be confirmed here.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: No annual median wage value was recorded in the agent predicted output; this aligns with missing wage data in the snapshot.

criteria.criterion: Record current employment (national Wages & Employment Trends value)
criteria.description: Report the current employment count as displayed on the Summary Report using the national Wages & Employment Trends value. Full credit if the correct national employment count is provided; do not overly penalize minor comma/spacing formatting differences if the number is correct. Partial credit if an employment figure is given but it is unclear whether it is the national Wages & Employment Trends value or if a different figure is used. Full credit (no penalty) if the agent cannot access this value due to page access/rendering issues and clearly reports this.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Screenshot evidence analysis for Criterion 5 shows no national current employment figure visible in the screenshot (no Wages & Employment Trends panel visible).
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: Not visible in the provided view is not an uncontrollable blocker. The agent did not extract the value. Score to 0.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: No employment metrics or "Wages & Employment Trends" area is visible; the page view is focused on the occupation description and the "Tasks" list.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: The agent did not report current employment and said the numeric values were not visible. The screenshot contains no current employment count, so the agent could not have transcribed it from this view. Criterion not satisfied because the required field is not recorded.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: None: the screenshot lacks an employment count, consistent with the agent’s stated limitation.

dom_model_context.verifier_evidence: DOM-model state 0 does not display any national current employment figure; evidence status is UNKNOWN (may be further down). No DOM-confirmed blocker is present.
dom_model_context.verifier_justification: Same logic as Criterion 4: missing in the snapshot is not a confirmed uncontrollable blocker. The agent did not provide the current employment value, so the baseline 3/3 should be adjusted down to 0/3.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: DOM_MODEL_STATE_INDEX: 0 visible content does not include a national "current employment" figure or any employment-count formatting (comma-separated counts) within a Wages & Employment Trends section.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis:
EVIDENCE_STATUS: UNKNOWN
The current employment (national) value is not present in the provided DOM evidence, so it cannot be extracted or verified.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: Agent predicted output did not provide a current employment number; consistent with the snapshot not containing it.

criteria.description: Report both (a) the projected-growth descriptor/wording (e.g., Faster than average) and (b) the projected-growth percentage/rate as displayed. Full credit if both are correct; allow minor formatting differences that do not change meaning (e.g., spacing around %). Partial credit if only one of wording or rate is correct, or if wording is paraphrased but the intent is correct. Full credit (no penalty) if the agent cannot access/verify the growth wording and/or rate due to page access/rendering issues and explicitly states what could not be retrieved.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Screenshot evidence analysis for Criterion 6 shows no projected-growth wording or percentage visible in the screenshot.
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: The agent did not report projected-growth wording and rate; no blocker is confirmed beyond not being in the current viewport. Score to 0.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The screenshot does not show any projected growth section, wording (e.g., faster-than-average), or any percentage rate. Only the occupation header, description, and part of the "Tasks" list are visible.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: The agent did not provide projected-growth wording or rate, stating they were not visible. The screenshot confirms no growth wording/rate is present in the captured area, so the information is not recorded and the criterion is not met.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: No discrepancy: absence of growth information in the screenshot aligns with the agent’s inability to transcribe it.

dom_model_context.verifier_evidence: DOM-model state 0 contains no projected-growth descriptor/wording and no percentage rate; evidence status is UNKNOWN (may be elsewhere). No DOM-confirmed blocker is present.
dom_model_context.verifier_justification: The baseline gave full credit due to supposed snapshot limitation, but the DOM does not confirm an external blocker—only that the relevant section isn’t shown. The agent did not report the projected-growth wording and rate. Adjust from 3/3 to 0/3.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: DOM_MODEL_STATE_INDEX: 0 visible content contains no "Projected growth" label, no growth descriptor (e.g., faster-than-average wording), and no percentage value related to projections.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis:
EVIDENCE_STATUS: UNKNOWN
Neither the projected-growth wording nor the projected-growth percentage/rate is shown in the provided DOM snapshot, so this criterion cannot be satisfied from the evidence.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: Agent predicted output did not report projected-growth wording or rate; consistent with missing projection data in the snapshot.

criteria.description: Report the projected job openings as displayed on the Summary Report, using the national figure shown. Full credit if the correct value is provided; do not overly penalize minor comma formatting differences if the number is correct. Partial credit if an openings number is given but it is unclear whether it is the projected job openings metric shown on the Summary Report. Full credit (no penalty) if the agent cannot access this value due to page access/rendering issues and clearly reports this.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Screenshot evidence analysis for Criterion 7 shows no projected job openings number visible in the screenshot.
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: The agent did not report projected job openings; lack of visibility in this viewport is not an uncontrollable blocker. Score to 0.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: No projected job openings number is visible in the screenshot; the view is on "Occupation-Specific Information" and "Tasks".
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: The agent did not report projected job openings and stated those numeric values were not visible. The screenshot contains no job openings figure, so the field is not recorded and the criterion is not satisfied.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: None: the screenshot does not show projected openings, consistent with the agent’s statement.

dom_model_context.verifier_evidence: DOM-model state 0 shows no “Projected job openings” label or openings count; evidence status is UNKNOWN (could be below the fold). No DOM-confirmed blocker is present.
dom_model_context.verifier_justification: As with wage/employment/growth, absence from the captured viewport is not a confirmed uncontrollable blocker. The agent did not report openings. Adjust baseline from 2/2 to 0/2.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: DOM_MODEL_STATE_INDEX: 0 visible content contains no "Projected job openings" label and no openings count (comma-separated count) in the displayed viewport text.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis:
EVIDENCE_STATUS: UNKNOWN
Projected job openings are not present in the provided DOM snapshot; therefore the openings figure cannot be verified or transcribed exactly as displayed.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: Agent predicted output did not provide projected job openings; consistent with snapshot omissions.

criteria.criterion: Respect task constraints and stopping condition
criteria.description: Use only the specified O*NET profile (15-1252.00) and the national Wages & Employment Trends values displayed; do not follow training-provider or job-search links; stop after recording the requested fields. Full credit if constraints are followed and output includes the requested fields (or explicitly reports which fields could not be retrieved due to access/rendering issues). Partial credit if minor extraneous information is included but does not rely on prohibited links/other occupations and all requested fields are still correctly provided. No credit if the agent clearly uses other occupations/sources when the O*NET page is accessible, or follows prohibited links and uses them as sources for the reported values.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Screenshot evidence analysis for Criterion 8 shows the agent stayed on the correct O*NET occupation page; no evidence of following prohibited links. The agent output, however, does not contain the requested recorded fields (beyond indirectly referencing some header info).
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: Constraints about using the correct profile and not following training/job-search links appear respected, but the stopping condition (record all requested fields) was not met. Partial credit.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The screenshot shows the user is on the O*NET OnLine page for "Software Developers 15-1252.00" with a visible "Bright Outlook" badge and "Updated 2026". The visible content includes the occupation description and the "Tasks" list. No evidence is shown of following external links (e.g., training providers/job search).
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: Constraint compliance appears okay based on the screenshot (correct profile, no prohibited link navigation shown). However, the stopping condition/output requirement (record all requested fields: title/code, bright outlook, job zone, wage, employment, growth wording/rate, openings) is not met in the agent’s predicted output: it did not record most fields and instead gave instructions. Thus, while constraints are respected, the task completion and stopping condition are not satisfied.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: The agent’s predicted output claims inability to see numeric values and does not provide the requested structured set of fields. The screenshot shows some of those fields (title, code, Bright Outlook) are visible, yet the agent did not fully record them as requested.

dom_model_context.verifier_evidence: DOM-model state 0 confirms the agent is on the correct O*NET summary URL and shows no evidence of following prohibited training-provider/job-search links. However, the agent’s final output did not record the requested fields (title/code, Job Zone, wage, employment, growth, openings), despite at least title/code and Bright Outlook label being visible in the DOM snapshot.
dom_model_context.verifier_justification: The agent generally respected source/platform constraints (stayed on correct profile; no prohibited link-following shown), but did not meet the stopping condition/output requirement to record the requested fields when at least some were available. This warrants partial rather than full credit for this criterion.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: DOM_MODEL_STATE_INDEX: 0 shows the agent is on the correct summary URL. Visible content includes multiple links such as "My Next Move for Veterans" and "Details", but there is no evidence the agent clicked training-provider or job-search links. The agent predicted output states an inability to view numeric values and does not report any extracted wage/employment/growth/openings fields.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis:
EVIDENCE_STATUS: PARTIAL
Constraints about using only the 15-1252.00 profile appear satisfied (correct URL shown). There is no DOM evidence of prohibited link-following. However, the stopping condition requires recording all requested fields (title/code, Bright Outlook status, Job Zone title, annual median wage, current employment, projected-growth wording and rate, projected job openings). The agent predicted output did not record several required fields, so the task completion/stop condition is not met even though the agent did stop without providing them.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: Missing required recordings: Job Zone title, annual median wage, current employment, projected-growth wording and rate, projected job openings (and Bright Outlook status not explicitly transcribed as a field).
